context_stem: xAI will investigate...and take action...and implement long-term solutions:
excerpt: When reportable under applicable laws and regulations, xAI will provide the relevant authorities with a copy of the incident report within the required deadlines
paraphrase: Where legally reportable, xAI will provide relevant authorities a copy of the incident report within required deadlines.

excerpt: xAI maintains internal governance structures and practices designed to meet the requirements of applicable laws and ensure the implementation of the processes in this FAIF.
paraphrase: xAI maintains internal governance structures meeting applicable legal requirements and ensuring implementation of FAIF processes.

excerpt: xAI’s internal governance practices include managing risks across the lifecycle of our models and ongoing legal and compliance reviews to ensure that risk management functions adhere to this FAIF.
paraphrase: Governance practices include lifecycle risk management and ongoing legal/compliance reviews ensuring adherence to the FAIF.
